findings.summary: Mixed retirement plans do not share their ledger cursor with unrecorded joined generation candidates.
findings.impact: A preceding unrecorded generation register/clear operation rewrites the plan ledger inode and causes a later unchanged terminal candidate to fail. An unrecorded candidate also lacks the shared replacement refusal after another candidate consumes the plan.
findings.required_fix: Share a plan cursor across all returned candidates; advance only after verified own mutations; retain refusal of external identical-content ledger replacements in either application order.
findings.status: Sent to implementation agent; v5 fix in progress.

findings.summary: Before-rename completed retirement may appear twice in one API prune plan.
findings.impact: The original scrubbed basename can be returned from the durable ledger and again from expired flat-file retention. First removal succeeds and the duplicate produces a misleading failed prune result.
findings.required_fix: Deduplicate exact planned basename/inode within the held artifact directory and exercise the API plan/apply path before and after the retirement rename.
findings.status: Sent to implementation agent; regression written, actual API execution remains pending.

disposition: Changes required; v4 freeze released for fixes. No clean review claim.
